headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Retains Interest Rate at 23%
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria maintained its benchmark interest rate at 23%, citing five consecutive months of moderating headline inflation supported by exchange rate stability.
why: Central bank rate decisions dictate domestic commercial lending rates, bond yields, and currency stability.

impacts.name: Nigerian Central Bank Rate
impacts.why: Holding the monetary policy rate unchanged affects domestic borrowing costs and fixed income yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A policy hold in line with easing inflation trends stabilizes expectations for domestic credit conditions.
